question: In a certain code language, 'BLADE' is written as 'CKBCF' and 'CHALK' is written as 'DGBKL. How will 'DIGITAL' be written in that language?
solution:
The logic followed here is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/32770a41ec977af2dbb04b2c1d6f230ef042728ed79e49316de972bbb5af777d.png] 

 
• [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/586e39db7cb9063291810523f616dc13111e50d1ff32e57dac295a4f379a456c.png] 
 
• [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/35ab450a144e3f3aceddeff5b4eb9a915327000d25531584b6acb096efb2a6b0.png] 

Similarly,

 
• [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/01f2b37c553b0905dddcb4d96b08f4332fd6f5e4f90bbc97a9a92fa7bb8bc95b.png] 

Hence, '**EHHHUZM**' is the correct answer.
